scope.goal: Optimize browser-backed batch action scheduling without reducing discovery source coverage.
non_goals: reduce source coverage as the primary optimization
access platform in this planning step
change code in this planning step
required_boundaries: timeout/auth_failed/missing_device_id/parser_boundary/business_field_gap must be source_gap, not no-risk evidence
raw bundle must be reused by local P0 foundation, replay, provenance, and eval

primary_definition.definition: primary is the first-round foundational source group, not a single interface
primary_definition.d2_primary_186s_interpretation: D2 primary=186s means accumulated wait across the foundational source group; it cannot be attributed to one interface without action-level timing.
primary_definition.current_gap: primary lacks action-level timing in the summary
primary_definition.optimization_direction: split primary internally into fast_core, risk_core, unstable instead of cutting primary coverage

blocking_core.description: Sources needed for the first usable discovery report or a meaningful source-gap statement.
blocking_core.wait_policy: wait until terminal state or core budget

nonblocking_broad.description: Broad discovery sources that preserve coverage but should not block the first report.
nonblocking_broad.wait_policy: include if available before cutoff; otherwise pending_tail

slow_tail.description: Known slow or unstable sources that append later and never block the first report.
slow_tail.wait_policy: run under tail budget and circuit breaker

conditional_followup.description: Sources requiring anchors such as device_id, event_id, photo_id, or Track readiness.
conditional_followup.wait_policy: run only when anchor exists; otherwise source_gap

source_action_layers.notes: event chain, client runtime, URI, IP/network, token/credential actions
valuable operation history but auth/parser gaps must not block
historical profile/content submissions and enforcement facts
content entry source and followup anchor
must preserve raw device_id references for riskData
event/policy anchor source, not primary feature source
high timeout risk; append later if completed
feature source when stable; timeout is source_gap
NEED_DATA_SYNC/HIVE_UNFINISHED is track_business_field_gap, not behavior evidence
cannot infer duration/active days/lineage from readiness-only responses
extended social graph with high fanout risk

do_not_wait_for: weapon_inventory riskData when raw device_id is absent
source/action groups with open circuit breaker

gap_states.pending_tail: source still running or intentionally allowed to append later
gap_states.source_gap: source reached terminal failure or cannot execute due to missing anchor
gap_states.business_field_gap: transport completed but business fields are unavailable
gap_states.missing_required_fields: followup cannot run due to missing anchor

rules: preserve original first-report conclusion and timestamp
emit revised conclusion delta when late evidence changes interpretation
distinguish first-report evidence from late-append evidence in replay/provenance

open_conditions: two consecutive chunks for the same source/action exceed timeout budget
timeout ratio for a source/action exceeds 50% within the wave
on_open: stop scheduling more chunks for that source/action in current wave
mark remaining users as source_gap with gap_reason=circuit_open_timeout

suggested_max_waits.slow_tail: 30-60s tail budget per wave, not first-report blocking

special_cases.auth_failed: stop repeated retries and mark auth_session_issue
special_cases.missing_device_id: do not attempt riskData; mark not_executed_missing_device_id
special_cases.NEED_DATA_SYNC_or_HIVE_UNFINISHED: stop Track behavior expansion and mark track_business_field_gap
special_cases.parser_boundary: do not treat transport completion as business evidence

flow: browser-backed batch writes immutable raw bundle
raw bundle includes source status, timing, chunk metadata, and safe raw references
P0 foundation reads raw bundle locally
candidate replay reads P0 artifacts locally
discovery provenance reads replay outputs locally
oracle/final eval reads local replay/provenance outputs

expected_impact.full_all_source_wave: reduce first-report latency by roughly 30%-50% without dropping source coverage
expected_impact.targeted_supplement_runs: keep around 30-90 seconds when only confirming specific gaps
expected_impact.local_replay_eval: seconds to low-minute range after raw bundle cache is available
